entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Gahhh! Here I was hopin' we'd find[n]that video already...

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: They sure ain't makin' it easy for us,[n]are they?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You can say that again—I hope it's close,[n]though.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I'm getting signs of some super-strong[n]Shadows up ahead. Maybe you'll find[n]it there?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There's a solid chance you'll have to[n]fight for it, though. Be careful on your[n]tape hunt.
